description: This file defines the 'UpgradeCommand' class, a console command for performing system upgrades within the OrangeHRM enterprise HRM system. The class manages interaction with the user, database connection checks, version migrations, and configuration file creation as part of the upgrade process.
external_files: API controllers for upgrade data registration and configuration

classes.name: UpgradeCommand
classes.description: A console command class handling the upgrade process for the OrangeHRM system, including database checks, version upgrades, and configuration management.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the command, with aliases set to 'upgrade'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command-line options for database connection info and current version.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method executing the upgrade process, including user prompts, system checks, version migration, and config file creation.

methods.name: drawDatabaseInfoTable
methods.description: Displays database connection parameters in a table format.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Checks if a specific command-line option value is non-empty.

methods.name: throwIfParamEmpty
methods.description: Throws an exception if a required option is missing or empty.
